title: 卡莉丝塔·蓝丝带花瓶
description: 青蓝幽灵战士卡莉丝塔穿完整甲胄，给花瓶系小丝带，长矛单独安全靠架，没有刺穿身体。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kalista is a spectral adult warrior woman with cool blue-green skin, long dark hair, a pointed armored headpiece, luminous eyes, and angular dark armor. Preserve her lean spear-warrior silhouette but cover the torso and legs fully, using soft crayon spirit accents instead of frightening wounds. Her long spear rests safely in a stand; do not show spears piercing her body.
art_direction.scene: She kneels beside a low stone table and ties a little blue ribbon around a vase holding one pale flower. Her free hand steadies the vase with careful fingers. A soft archway and a simple curtain make the setting quietly welcoming, while the spear stays separate and the spirit glow remains gentle and contained.
art_direction.palette: soft teal, navy armor, pale blue ribbon, ivory
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
